result:
Here's how I read it: members who book a lane get a text at 18:00 the evening before, so fewer lanes sit empty while people on the waiting list miss out. Anyone who ticked "no texts, please" gets nothing.

What I found in the booking app:

- **Texting is already set up.** The newsletter goes out through your SMS provider, so the reminder can reuse that. Nothing sends reminders yet.
- **The opt-out leaves a big gap.** 23% of members have "no texts" ticked, so they'd get no reminder at all. Email can't easily fill the gap, because 61% of members have no email address on file.
- **A reminder alone may not free the lane.** If someone who can't make it has no quick way to cancel from the text, the lane still sits empty, even if fewer people forget.

Correct me if I've got any of that wrong.

The question that would most change what gets built: what should happen for the members who said no texts?

- **No reminder for them (my pick).** This is simplest and fully respects the tick. About a quarter of bookers stay uncovered.
- **Email them instead, where we have an address.** This covers some of that quarter but adds an email path. I can count how many no-text members actually have an email first.

Or if you'd rather I just dive in, say so.
